Record Destruction
Officially destroy all waste logged since the last destruction. This records the event, marks those waste records destroyed, and produces a printable Destruction Log + Attestation per batch.
Pending — waste since last destruction
Destruction History
Drying Loss Report
Each destruction event with the waste records it covered — recorded weight vs. actual weight destroyed, so you can verify the drying loss.
Reconciliation Check
Compares each event's stored destroyed weight against the waste records that still exist in the app today. "Phantom" weight comes from waste records that were later deleted or reassigned (e.g. the PB-002/PB-003 cleanup) — it inflates the destruction totals above your live waste data. Read-only; nothing is changed.

Pheno Info

Seed batches track each individual pheno; production and mother batches track a single plant. Pick a batch, then log dated observations, ratings and notes.

Airtable access (data tools only)

The app runs on the shared database — these credentials are only used by the one-off data migration / reconcile tools, which look up the tables automatically. Growers don't need to touch this.

Flower-day milestones

Tasks that appear as alerts on the Batch Management page when a flowering batch reaches each flower day (F-Day = days since Flower Start). Saved on this device.

Adding a Flower Day that already exists replaces its task list.

Grower access

Share this page URL with Jordan and Brandon. On mobile tap Share then Add to Home Screen to install it like a native app. On desktop bookmark it. All entries sync directly to the shared database in real time.
